description: This file defines the Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Resource class, which manages resource autoloading, class path resolution, and resource type registration within the Zend Framework's autoloading system.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Resource
classes.description: Class responsible for resource autoloading, class path resolution, and resource type management in Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource autoloader with options, sets namespace and base path, and registers the autoloader.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic 'get<Resourcename>()' method calls to load resources of specific types.

methods.name: getClassPath
methods.description: Calculates the file path for a given class name based on namespace and component mappings.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Attempts to autoload a class by resolving its path and including it.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets class properties based on provided options array.

methods.name: setNamespace
methods.description: Sets the namespace that this autoloader handles.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for resource classes.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieves the base path for resource classes.

methods.name: addResourceType
methods.description: Adds a new resource type with its path and optional namespace.

methods.name: addResourceTypes
methods.description: Adds multiple resource types at once.

methods.name: setResourceTypes
methods.description: Replaces all resource types with a new set.

methods.name: getResourceTypes
methods.description: Returns the current resource type mappings.

methods.name: hasResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource type is defined.

methods.name: setDefaultResourceType
methods.description: Sets the default resource type for loading.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a resource of a specified type, instantiating it if not already loaded.
